scope: Authenticated operator request to same main session, deliver=false; not a new human Telegram message.

content.text: I am a personal assistant for synthetic project planning, email, calendar, and web research. I can help you manage tasks, review emails, and analyze your schedule. I operate primarily through Telegram. I can read events from a synthetic calendar, and I can guide authenticated users to add or complete tasks through Telegram commands. I do not have access to personal records or USC email/calendar accounts.
